## Description
<!-- Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced in this pull request. -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance, dependencies, or tooling
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `test`: Adding or updating tests

## Target Branch
- [ ] `staging` (Standard feature/fix development)
- [ ] `main` (Release promotion from staging)

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch branched off up-to-date `staging` branch
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes without errors
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes without errors
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] No extraneous debug prints or files committed
- [ ] Branch can be safely deleted upon merge
